info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Order Processing API
info.description: The Order Processing API facilitates the seamless management of orders within the banking services ecosystem. This API allows users to initiate and submit orders for operational services efficiently. Typical consumers include banking personnel, financial systems, and third-party applications that require order processing capabilities. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline order workflows, enhance service delivery, and improve overall operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit and process an operational order in the system. It is designed to handle various types of orders and integrates with the order management workflow, ensuring that all necessary steps are taken from submission to fulfillment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a processing order to the operational services. It contains all the necessary information required to create and process the order.

201.description: Resource created successfully, indicating that the processing order was initiated.
